label: Command
description: Fired from the command line: wilanis run <trigger path> [--flag=value ...] [--file path] [--out path] [args...]. The context hands flags (as strings), args, cwd, and the file named by --file as a blob; the trigger's input mapping picks what the graph gets. The answer is printed as JSON; a blob answer is streamed to --out, or to stdout. A refusal prints as { reason, message } -- a challenge with its id and how to answer it beside them -- and exits 1. A fault prints `fault at '<node>': <message>` on stderr, nothing on stdout, and exits 1; `--verbose` prints the report.

command.description: a memorable alias for the trigger

file.description: the file --file names, streamed into the blob registry. A trigger that reads it needs the flag: without it, wilanis run refuses the input. Read the blob with a @blob operation in a data graph
